name: Apple Mail
summary: Read your mail in Apple Mail
description:
Gives KeepTalking read access to the mail in Apple Mail on this Mac: list accounts and mailboxes, list and search messages, read a message and hand its attachments over as KeepTalking files. Powered by apple-mail-mcp by Patrick Freyer (open source, MIT), which talks to Mail through AppleScript.

Read only: nothing here sends, moves, flags or deletes mail. The first call asks macOS to let KT Companion control Mail (Privacy & Security → Automation); no Full Disk Access is needed. Each action instance can be limited to some of your Mail accounts.

kinds.name: apple-mail
kinds.description: Read the user's mail in Apple Mail on this Mac. Start with list_accounts, then list_inbox_emails for the newest messages or search_emails to find some; both return JSON rows whose internet_message_id (with the row's account and mailbox) addresses read_email. read_email returns headers, the plain-text body and numbered attachments; get_email_attachment writes one of them into the call's `attachment` output. Read only: nothing here sends, moves, flags or deletes mail. Accounts outside this instance's scope are refused.

tool.description: Which operation: list_accounts — Mail accounts this instance may read; list_mailboxes — Mailboxes (folders) of an account, with message counts; get_mailbox_unread_counts — Unread counts per mailbox, or per-account inbox totals with summary_only; list_inbox_emails — Newest inbox messages first, as JSON rows carrying internet_message_id for read_email; search_emails — Search one account's mailbox by subject, sender, body text, dates, flags, read status or attachments; JSON rows carry internet_message_id; get_email_thread — Messages of a conversation, matched by subject; read_email — Read one message: headers, the plain-text body and its numbered attachments (name, type, size); get_email_attachment — Write one attachment of a message into the call's `attachment` output

account.description: Mail account name from list_accounts; omit for every account this instance may read

attachment.description: The attachment's number from read_email, or its file name

has_attachments.description: Only messages with (true) or without (false) attachments

include_zero.description: Include mailboxes with no unread messages

mailbox.description: Mailbox name (default INBOX); "All" searches every mailbox

message_id.description: The message's internet_message_id from list_inbox_emails or search_emails (its Message-ID header, not the numeric message_id)
